d: Surviving in the wilderness is never easy, especially when danger strikes and resources are limited. In Dual Survival, survival experts face some of the most dangerous survival situations, relying on their outdoor survival skills, bushcraft techniques and wilderness navigation to make it through. From dangerous wildlife encounters and extreme weather to building shelters and finding essential natural resources, every challenge tests their survival strategies and ability to adapt.
